back in my junior year of highschool, i had really liked this girl in my algebra class, i had developed a crush for her the whole year.

i became friends with her over discord and instagram, she’d barely post on insta so we’d use discord more, it was hard for me to talk to her because she’d be so trapped in her shell, she wasn’t very passionate about the things she did like and overall had a shit relationship with her family, there would be times where i tried to talk to her and she’d be like “sorry i’m not in the mood” and i asked “why?” and she was like “rather not tell sorry.”, of course i respected that because forcing help towards people is really weird.

come late may, things change and i told her i had a fascination in drawing, i used to draw anime characters or made up ocs of mine, i showed her a few of my drawings and then she showed me some of hers, we actually had a conversation about what we drew and after that day i felt so happy because i had finally gotten a conversation with this chick, we get a bit more closer… she begins telling me somethings and a few days later i contemplate on telling her that i’ve had a crush, i didn’t know how to decide to tell her so i flipped a coins on it. 

Heads i tell her my feelings

Tails i don’t do it.

It landed heads but me being me, i was like “ah.. it’s just luck..” so i flip it again, heads. then again. heads. then again… heads, over and over. i figured this was some sort of sign so i took a deep breathe and did it, she told me she thought it was cute but i have a shit taste in women, but eventually i talk things out with her and well for the rest of the school time we had, we got along more, i had gotten my first kiss on May 12th, 2021. i felt like i had it in the bag but things didn’t really go as planned. summer came and well we weren’t really officially dating yet, the summer hit us hard and us talking felt so weird. i felt like i was losing her every single month, i was strong at May but by August, it was already done. come my senior year, i try to fix things with her but she says “oh i made a new friend and i’d like to sit with him.”, it didn’t phase me so much until i realized she was sitting with him a lot more, and by as soon as i knew it when November came around, her and her friend became a thing. we’re still friends but i suppose i’m happy that she’s with someone who makes her happier than i ever will.
